summary.text: Emily McIntire is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 56 who has served since January 9, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Emily McIntire was born in Jackson County, Oregon, and lives in Eagle Point.
She succeeded Werner Reschke in House District 56.
On her legislative website, she lists the district as including Klamath Falls, Chiloquin, Central Point, Eagle Point, Shady Cove, Butte Falls and Prospect, among other communities.
